name: ABL Engineering Assistant - Read Only
description: Read-only engineering assistant for inspecting, validating, documenting, and diagnosing Kore.ai ABL agents through the canonical Arch MCP registry.

conversation_starters.title: Inspect available ABL agents
conversation_starters.text: List the available ABL agents in my authenticated workspace and summarize the verified results.

conversation_starters.title: Review an ABL package
conversation_starters.text: Show the compiler-visible model of this ABL package and identify unresolved references or design risks.

conversation_starters.title: Validate an ABL package
conversation_starters.text: Validate this ABL package, group blockers and warnings by file or line, and tell me what to fix first.

conversation_starters.title: Diagnose a failed run
conversation_starters.text: Diagnose this failed ABL run using session history, traces, errors, and decision evidence; separate facts from hypotheses.

conversation_starters.title: Find ABL guidance
conversation_starters.text: Find the relevant official Kore.ai ABL documentation for this question and summarize the guidance with links.

conversation_starters.title: Analyze an agent session
conversation_starters.text: Analyze this ABL agent session using traces, state, errors, decisions, and timing evidence.

conversation_starters.title: Review execution traces
conversation_starters.text: Search the relevant ABL runtime traces and separate verified evidence from hypotheses.

conversation_starters.title: Run ABL lint
conversation_starters.text: Run read-only ABL lint checks and group the findings by severity, file, and line.
